title: Financial Planning and Analyst
description:
Job title: Financial Planning and Analyst
  
  
Location: Bawal
  
  
At Johnson Matthey, your work will matter. As a Financial Planning and Analyst, you’ll join a world leader in platinum group metals with over 200 years of history and innovation. You’ll help tackle the world’s biggest challenges - cutting emissions, powering modern society and enhancing lives - as we continue to apply, refine and recycle metals that matter, for a healthier and more resilient future.
  
  
**The role:**
As a Financial Planning and Analyst, you will help drive our goals by:
  
  
Prepare reports, forecasts, and budgets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to financial guidelines and accounting standards.
  
  

* Provide financial analysis, including variance analysis, trend analysis, and profitability analysis, to identify key performance drivers, risks, opportunities.
* Support the business to drive and improve performance, this includes running and delivering first line analysis, participating in drawing conclusions on changes required.
* Participate in preparing presentations and reports for key stakeholder groups (Business Partners, Senior Management), highlighting financial performance, trends, and potential risks
* Participate in compiling and analyzing data to support the preparation for business performance reviews and business results commentary.
* Participate in the development and improvement of financial models, tools, and processes to enhance financial planning and analysis capabilities.
* Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives, providing financial expertise and guidance to support business growth, process optimisation, and risk management.
* Perform continuous improvement initiatives to enhance financial planning and analysis capabilities, streamline processes, and improve data integrity and accuracy.

**Key skills that will help you succeed in this role:**

* Advance Excel
* Power BI
* SAP

**Required Qualification and Experience for this role:**

* Education - CA or CMA
* Experience - 6+ Years with with Strong financial, analytical and communication project management skills; Business orientation and interest.

Even if you only match some of the skills, we’d love to hear from you to discuss further!
  
  
**What we offer:**
We make sure salaries are fair, competitive and aligned to individual roles, experience and responsibilities. We are also supportive of hybrid and flexible working and where applicable, offer life, medical and other benefits that support our employees’ financial and physical wellbeing, such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation and performance-based rewards.
* Comprehensive medical insurance.
* Life and accident insurance.
* Retirement benefits (Provident Fund & Gratuity).
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing initiatives.
* Learning, development, and career progression opportunities.

**Ready to make a meaningful impact on your career and the environment? Join us and help shape a sustainable future while advancing your career!**
At JM, inclusivity is central to our values. We create an environment where everyone can thrive, embracing diverse perspectives to tackle challenges and ensure all colleagues feel valued and connected.
  
  
For any queries or accessibility requirements, please contact GlobalRecruit@matthey.com. We will work with you to make suitable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. All conversations are confidential, and your feedback is welcome to help us provide an accessible and positive recruitment experience.
  
  
Closing date for applications: This job advertisement will be posted for a minimum of 2 weeks; early application is advised.
  
  
#MyCareerMatters #CareersThatMatter
  
  
To submit your application, please click the "Apply" button online.
  
  
All applications are carefully considered and your details will be stored on our secure Application Management System. This is used throughout Johnson Matthey for the selection of suitable candidates for our vacancies as they arise. Johnson Matthey respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.
  
  
For more information about how your personal data is used please view our privacy notice:  Johnson Matthey Privacy Notice. By applying for this role and creating an account you are agreeing to the notice.
  
  
Johnson Matthey Plc is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, religion or belief.

title: Specialist - Spend Analytics
description: Role: Specialist - Spend AnalyticsLocation: GurgaonFull/ Part-time: Full TimeBuild a career with confidenceCarrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.About The RoleThe Specialist – Spend Analytics will be responsible for transforming procurement spend data into actionable cost intelligence to drive insights and strategic decision-making related to procurement and cost optimization, generating actionable intelligence for the Global and Regional supply chain teams to achieve financial goals and improve overall operational efficiency. The role combines rigorous spend analytics with deep should-cost expertise — leveraging tools such as aPriori to build fact-based cost models that challenge supplier pricing, identify savings opportunities, and support high-stakes negotiations. A working knowledge of AI and machine learning techniques for spend analytics, anomaly detection, and pattern recognition will be a strong advantage, enabling the specialist to continuously elevate the analytical maturity of the COE and deliver commercially impactful outcomes at scale.Key Responsibilities: Spend Data Analysis & InterpretationConduct in-depth analysis of spend data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies across categories and suppliers.Utilize statistical techniques and data visualization tools to transform complex datasets into clear, meaningful insights for stakeholders.Leverage tools such as Python, R, VBA, and advanced Excel to build scalable analytical workflows and automate repetitive data processing tasks.Apply machine learning techniques to enhance spend classification, outlier detection, and predictive analytics capabilities.Increase automation across key steps of the spend analysis lifecycle to improve speed, accuracy, and consistency of outputs.Deliver robust, audit-ready spend analysis that supports strategic sourcing decisions at both global and regional levels. Should Costing & Cost IntelligenceBuild and validate detailed should-cost models for Build to Print categories including plastics, Sheet Metal, pressure die cast (PDC) components, machining, leveraging knowledge of raw materials, manufacturing processes, and cost drivers.Maintain and continuously refine cost models using aPriori or equivalent tools to reflect current market dynamics and input cost movements.Drive cost reduction initiatives through value engineering, design-to-cost analysis, and supplier negotiations.Partner with engineering and commodity teams to apply should-cost outputs to RFQ benchmarking and fact-based negotiation preparation. Market Intelligence & Sourcing StrategyMonitor global market trends, raw material indices, supplier landscapes, and technological developments in the HVAC and related industries.Leverage market intelligence to inform sourcing strategies, risk mitigation plans, and cost management decisions.Identify alternative suppliers, emerging markets, and innovative manufacturing processes to enhance competitiveness. Negotiation PreparationPrepare structured negotiation packs for category managers, including should-cost breakdowns, market benchmarks, supplier scorecards, and price-volume analyses.Conduct supplier cost walk-throughs and price justification reviews to equip sourcing teams with robust challenge frameworks.Model negotiation scenarios and sensitivity analyses, including the impact of raw material price movements on target pricing.Track negotiation outcomes and feed results back into cost models and spend databases to improve future analytical cycles. Implementation & Value CaptureDrive or support the execution of initiatives generated from spend analytics, converting insights into real, measurable savings.Ensure consistent tracking and reporting of value capture against identified savings pipeline. Stakeholder CollaborationCollaborate with stakeholders across the organisation — supply chain, engineering, operations, and quality — to understand spend analysis requirements and translate them into actionable insights.Present findings, opportunity assessments, and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner to senior leadership.Provide guidance and support in interpreting spend analytics findings and implementing recommendations across functions.Facilitate cross-functional workshops to align on category strategies, savings priorities, and data quality improvement plans. Continuous Improvement & GovernanceDrive process improvements in sourcing, RFQ management, cost analysis, and spend reporting cycles.Ensure compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and ethical sourcing standards.Support digitalization and analytics initiatives, including deployment of BI platforms and AI-driven spend intelligence tools, to enhance sourcing effectiveness.RequirementsBachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Data Science, or a related discipline.8+ years of experience in spend analytics, strategic sourcing, or cost engineering within a manufacturing or industrial procurement environment.Strong understanding of part cost structures, manufacturing processes, and tooling across key direct spend categories.Hands-on experience with aPriori or similar should-cost software is mandatory.Experience with BI and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).Familiarity with AI/ML techniques applied to procurement analytics is a strong plus.Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for analytics and presentations is mandatory.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong interpersonal abilities for stakeholder management.High learning agility, accountability, and effective collaboration skills.Ability to work effectively in a global environment with stakeholders located in different regions.Strong attention to detail with sharp observational skills to identify issues accurately and articulate findings effectively.BenefitsWe are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.Have peace of mind and body with our health insuranceDrive forward your career through professional development opportunitiesAchieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance ProgrammeOur commitment to youOur greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. title: Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager -
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**ROLE**
.
  
  
**Location:**
Badli, India
  
  
**About The Role**
Autoliv is looking for an experienced
**Assistant Manager / Senior Specialist- Customer Order Planning & Processing**
to lead demand planning, customer order management, inventory control, and supply chain coordination activities. The role is responsible for ensuring seamless order fulfillment, production alignment, inventory optimization, and customer satisfaction while driving key supply chain performance metrics.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Demand & Order Management
  
  

* Manage demand planning, schedule management, and delivery execution.
* Oversee daily intake, validation, and processing of domestic and export customer orders.
* Monitor customer forecasts versus firm orders and proactively communicate potential risks.
* Maintain accurate customer requirements in ERP systems.
* Manage customer escalations related to order discrepancies, billing issues, and delivery delays.

Supply Chain Planning & Coordination
  
  

* Release monthly SIOP plans and rolling resource plans.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align sales, production, and inventory requirements.
* Review and release production plans in coordination with PPC teams.
* Monitor SIOP performance against actual production and identify supply risks.
* Support demand planning activities for new projects and customer launches.

Inventory & Logistics Management
  
  

* Monitor inventory turns and Days on Hand (DOH).
* Drive inventory optimization initiatives and ensure stock availability.
* Coordinate with logistics partners, freight forwarders, and dispatch teams for timely deliveries.
* Manage safety stock levels and prioritize critical shipments during supply constraints.

Reporting & Performance Management
  
  

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Analyze order trends and contribute to demand forecasting activities.
* Track and report key operational metrics.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and drive automation initiatives.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop order processing and coordination teams.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Represent Supply Chain Management in cross-functional reviews and business discussions.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* 100% OTIF (On-Time In-Full) performance for OEM/OES customers.
* Demand Accuracy above 95%.
* Zero backlog for export and spare parts orders.
* Effective Order Cycle Time management.
* Inventory optimization and DOH control.
* Compliance with AS247 (Demand Forecast & Firm Orders).

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* PGDM or specialization in Supply Chain Management preferred.

**Experience**

* 11 to 13 years of experience in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Logistics, Customer Order Management, or related functions.
* Experience in the automotive manufacturing industry is preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  

* ERP-QAD proficiency.
* Advanced MS Office skills.
* Power BI knowledge.
* Inventory Management and Supply Chain Planning expertise.
* Demand Forecasting and Order Management experience.

Competencies
  
  
Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Leading and Deciding
* Supporting and Cooperating
* Interacting and Influencing
* Analyzing and Interpreting
* Organizing and Executing
* Adapting and Coping

Functional Competencies
  
  

* Customer Focus
* Global Perspective
* Innovation and Continuous Improvement
* Sound Decision Making
* Execution Excellence
* Accountability
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
* People Development and Team Leadership

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Self-motivated and confident professional.
* Pragmatic and results-oriented approach.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Collaborative team player with an innovative mindset.

**We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.**
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
  
  
**More lives saved – more life lived!**
